The '''Hardan plague''' was a virulent [[Disease/Legends|disease]]<ref name="CEH" /> known by the time of the [[Declaration of a New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Around this period, the inhabitants of [[Dagelin Minor]] imported a shipment of [[Insect/Legends|insectivorous]] flying [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] known as [[Bogan's brown nafen]] in response to an infestation of [[Dhuru fly|dhuru flies]]. Unfortunately, the nafen, which were notorious for being extremely efficient transmitters of disease, caused an outbreak of the Hardan plague on Dagelin Minor, leading to the deaths of ninety-eight percent of the whole population.<ref name="CG" />

According to the [[Boudolayz]] files,<ref name="THW" /> a native of the remote world of [[Shinbone]] and a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] was an orphan who claimed that his parents had died from the Hardan plague.<ref name="CEV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hardan plague was first mentioned in ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', a sourcebook released in [[1994]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CG" /> Then, the Hardan plague became part of the backstory of the hunter Beilert Valance.<ref name="THWC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin5|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Conclusion|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Conclusion}}</ref>
